move_masks: move binary masks in a 3D array by a specified (x, y) offset and resolution
calculate_masks_centroids: calculate the centroid coordinates of binary masks in a tensor
contains_holes: check if a 2D binary mask contains holes enclosed by foreground pixels
contains_multiple_segments: check if a 2D binary mask contains multiple unconnected foreground segments
filter_segments_by_distance: filter mask segments keeping the largest component and nearby ones within a distance threshold
